basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, working as a software developer. I have a strong passion for gaming, especially Pokemon, and I enjoy trading and discussing strategies. I'm an introvert by nature, but I find online communities to be a great way to connect with like-minded people. In my free time, I dabble in photography and occasionally post my work online. I tend to be a night owl, often browsing Reddit into the early hours of the morning. Currently single, I'm open to meeting new people both online and offline.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas, and I have been working in the tech industry for over five years. My expertise lies in software development and IT solutions. I am self-taught in photography and have developed my skills through various online courses and community feedback.
